PLAY · CHARACTERS AND SETTINGS

Owl’s Storybook World

Match each character to where their story happens. Tap the character, then the place.

Tap a character, then tap where their story happens.

Every story found its place!

Fish to the sea, farmer to the farm, astronaut to space.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains characters and settings on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Owl’s Storybook World worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
